task_name: Meridian and Ash - Sticker artwork production masters
client_brief:
Coffee sticker collection: recover four designs, add two, prepare the cutting sheet

Four recovered designs + two new designs = one six-sticker collection for Meridian and Ash.

Please prepare
- Recovered sticker artwork: 4 files. The design preserves its photographed original: meridian_window_mark.jpg for the window mark, with its painted lettering traced as painted rather than reset in a typeface, and meridian_bag_moth.jpg, meridian_bag_pourover.jpg and meridian_bag_ridgeline.jpg for bag designs 1, 2 and 3 respectively. Interior negative space remains open at 55 mm.
- Original companion sticker: 2 files. The drawing belongs stylistically beside the recovered collection. Interior negative space remains open at 55 mm.
- Separate sticker cut contour: 6 files. The contour is offset 2.5 mm from the artwork edge. The minimum corner radius is 3 mm. This file contains one cutting contour.
- Transparent sticker proof: 6 files. The proof corresponds to its named vector artwork.
- Sticker imposed production sheet: 1 file. The cut contours leave at least 10 mm clear from the sheet edge. Adjacent cut contours have at least 6 mm gutter. The CutContour layer can be selected separately from the artwork.

This commission includes reconstruction of the four photographed originals. The two companion illustrations are new designs. Set every artwork SVG to 55 mm on its long edge; the cut contour adds its 2.5 mm outward offset. The PNG proofs use a 1600 x 1600 px viewing canvas and are not a substitute for the physical-scale SVGs.

Supplied identity artwork
This commission explicitly includes paid reconstruction of the window mark and three bag illustrations from the supplied photographs. Those photographs are tracing references, not ready-to-place logos. They are intentionally retained: supplying finished vectors would remove the central work requested. No redesign of the four originals is authorised; the two companion stickers are the original-design portion.

What stays fixed
Recover the four supplied painted/printed designs faithfully as vector paths. Preserve photographed lettering rather than retyping it. Follow the 55 mm artwork scale, 2.5 mm contour offset, 3 mm minimum corner radius and printer sheet spacing.

Your design decisions
Draw two original companion illustrations with subject matter and visual rhythm that fit the coffee collection. Choose imposition within the printer's clearances. Newly set lettering follows the supplied type system; photographed lettering retains its original shape.

Delivery and fonts
Use the placement and export instructions listed with each requested file below. The downloadable OFL fonts in Source assets are the current typefaces for this commission; the typography card gives their roles and weights.

brand_identity.sector: Specialty coffee roaster and cafe selling stickers and merchandise at the till, at farmers markets and to wholesale accounts.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2016, Portland, Oregon, a converted machine shop with one counter, two market stalls and roughly forty wholesale accounts.
brand_identity.about: Meridian and Ash roast single origin coffee in a converted machine shop and sell it across their own counter, at two farmers markets and to about forty wholesale accounts. The merchandise table is half the fun: stickers people put on laptops and water bottles because they actually like the mark. The whole point is a range that feels made by hand, not bought by the case.
brand_identity.audience: Cafe regulars twenty to thirty five who buy a sticker at the till without deciding first, and wholesale buyers who hand them out with orders.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Impulse retail, three dollars a single and nine dollars a four pack. Priced to be handed out by the fistful, so the range has to read as abundant rather than precious.

palette.name: Roast Brown
palette.role: mandatory for the window mark wordmark, the moth design and type on a light ground
palette.usage: The main ink of the painted MERIDIAN & ASH wordmark in meridian_window_mark.jpg and of the moth printed on meridian_bag_moth.jpg; all type and labels on a light ground, as the wordmark and origin lines on meridian_shelfcard_2025.pdf. May be the main ink of a companion drawing.

palette.name: Kraft
palette.usage: A solid backing shape behind a drawing, recalling the kraft bags photographed in meridian_bag_moth.jpg, meridian_bag_pourover.jpg and meridian_bag_ridgeline.jpg, or detail reversed out of an ink. Never the main ink of a drawing and never type.

palette.name: Ash Green
palette.role: mandatory for the window mark roundel and the pour-over design
palette.usage: The filled roundel painted in meridian_window_mark.jpg and the pour-over printed on meridian_bag_pourover.jpg; a secondary type line such as the tagline or roast line, as on meridian_shelfcard_2025.pdf. May be the main ink of a companion drawing.

palette.name: Warm Cream
palette.role: optional; mandatory for the leaf and hairline ring of the window mark and for type reversed out of Roast Brown or Ash Green
palette.usage: The ash leaf and fine hairline ring painted in meridian_window_mark.jpg; type and fine detail reversed out of Roast Brown or Ash Green, as the caption set on the Roast Brown band and the ring and leaf veins on the roundel of meridian_shelfcard_2025.pdf; a fine line; or a solid backing shape. Never the main ink of a drawing.

palette.name: Brick Red
palette.role: mandatory for the ridge line design
palette.usage: The main ink of the ridge line printed on meridian_bag_ridgeline.jpg. May be the main ink of a companion drawing. On meridian_shelfcard_2025.pdf it sets only the price; it is not a type colour on the stickers or gang sheet.

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.usage: Fine detail inside a drawing only, no more than 5% of a sticker's inked area. Never the main ink, a backing shape, type or the wordmark; no supplied brand file uses it.

brand_identity.typography: Meridian and Ash runs on DM Serif Display Regular for display and Libre Franklin for everything else. Step 01, display, is DM Serif Display Regular capitals at 18 pt on 20 pt leading tracked 0.030 em on the arc, the 55 mm sticker setting at near 150 px cap height in a 1600 px proof, with MERIDIAN and ASH arched on a fixed 40 degree curve and the ampersand between them at 1.6 times their cap height, hanging below the arc into the artwork. Step 02, subheading, is DM Serif Display Regular capitals at 11 pt on 13 pt leading tracked 0.020 em for counter card and four pack headers, set flat and off the arc. Step 03, body, is Libre Franklin Regular 400 at 7 pt on 10.5 pt leading, tracking zero, set to a maximum of 65 characters, carrying the supporting line under the wordmark and all sticker copy. Step 04, fine print, is Libre Franklin Bold 700 capitals at 6 pt on 8.5 pt leading tracked 0.040 em for gang sheet labels and die line notes. The ampersand is never set at cap height.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm, a little wry, never precious. Example line: Pull one off the sheet, stick it on your laptop, come back for the other three.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: This commission explicitly includes paid reconstruction of the window mark and three bag illustrations from the supplied photographs. Those photographs are tracing references, not ready-to-place logos. They are intentionally retained: supplying finished vectors would remove the central work requested. No redesign of the four originals is authorised; the two companion stickers are the original-design portion.
brand_identity.values: Consistency people can trust, so the artwork stops being redrawn slightly differently every batch, and a hand made feel that reads as a real roastery rather than a franchise.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: A single oversized ampersand set at 1.6 times the cap height of MERIDIAN and ASH, hanging below the arc of the wordmark into the artwork, with the two words arched on a fixed 40 degree curve. At arm's length the ampersand is seen first.

type_system.text_face: Libre Franklin Regular 400 (Libre Franklin Bold 700 for gang sheet capitals)

scale.family: DM Serif Display Regular, capitals only
scale.note: The 55 mm sticker setting, near 150 px cap height in a 1600 px proof. MERIDIAN and ASH arch on a fixed 40 degree curve and the ampersand between them is set at 1.6 times their cap height, hanging below the arc into the artwork. Tracking opens slightly on the curve only so the letters stay evenly spaced around it.

scale.role: Subheading / H2 · counter card and four pack headers
scale.family: DM Serif Display Regular, capitals only
scale.note: Set flat, off the arc. Where an ampersand appears here it still runs at 1.6 times cap height, hanging below the baseline.

scale.sample: Pull one off the sheet and come back for the other three.
scale.note: The supporting line under the wordmark and every line of sticker and counter copy. Plain, warm, a little wry, never precious.
Gang sheet capitals, die line notes and slug labels in the artwork margin. Libre Franklin Bold 700 only, never DM Serif Display.

type_system.signature_move: A single oversized ampersand set at 1.6 times the cap height of MERIDIAN and ASH, hanging below the arc of the wordmark into the artwork, with the two words arched on a fixed 40 degree curve. At arm's length the ampersand is seen first.
rules: Never set the ampersand at cap height. It is always 1.6 times the cap height of MERIDIAN and ASH.
The ampersand always hangs below the arc, into the artwork, never sitting on the baseline.
MERIDIAN and ASH always arch on a fixed 40 degree curve, at every size.
DM Serif Display Regular is display only; Libre Franklin Regular 400 sets sticker copy and Libre Franklin Bold 700 the gang sheet capitals.
Keep the range reading abundant rather than precious: it is priced to be handed out by the fistful.
Hand made, not franchise: the artwork is drawn once and reused, never redrawn slightly differently each batch.
type_system.specimen_note: The samples load the supplied font files. Their display size is reduced for this guide; use the stated deliverable settings, not the on-screen sample size. Fonts and their OFL licences are downloadable in Source assets.
type_system.measurement_notes: Tracking in units means thousandths of an em; 1 pt is 1/72 inch. Pixel settings apply at final exported size. Font size is not cap height.
type_system.application: Apply these roles to newly set text in the requested deliverables. Preserve supplied logo artwork rather than retyping it. Recovered artwork retains its photographed lettering.
type_system.font_access: Use the attached OFL font files at the named weights. These files replace unavailable commercial fonts for this commission. Do not substitute another family or simulate a missing weight.

palette_rules.distribution: Each recovered design keeps the ink it was painted or printed in: Roast Brown for the wordmark in meridian_window_mark.jpg and the moth on meridian_bag_moth.jpg, Ash Green for the roundel in meridian_window_mark.jpg and the pour-over on meridian_bag_pourover.jpg, Warm Cream for the leaf and hairline ring in meridian_window_mark.jpg, Brick Red for the ridge line on meridian_bag_ridgeline.jpg. Each companion takes its main ink from Roast Brown, Ash Green and Brick Red. Kraft and Warm Cream are secondary: backing shapes, detail reversed out of an ink, or fine lines such as a hairline ring, never the main ink. Ink Black is fine detail only, no more than 5% of a sticker's inked area. Type on a light ground is Roast Brown, or Ash Green for a secondary line; type on Roast Brown or Ash Green is Warm Cream, as on meridian_shelfcard_2025.pdf. Sticker backgrounds stay transparent. Palette hex values define sRGB source colours. In the print PDF, convert them with PSOcoated_v3.icc; evaluate the colour-managed proof, not literal RGB hex values inside the CMYK file.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour on the stickers, proofs and gang sheet is used solid, at 100% opacity; no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode. A proof is transparent only outside the artwork and in its open, uninked negative space; every inked area is fully opaque, and partial transparency occurs only as anti-aliasing along edges, with no white or coloured rectangle behind it.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes for any artwork, type, backing shape, label or mark. The cut paths on the CutContour layer are production lines, not artwork, and are exempt. No colour is sampled from a photograph.
palette_rules.photography: No photograph appears in any deliverable. meridian_window_mark.jpg, meridian_bag_moth.jpg, meridian_bag_pourover.jpg and meridian_bag_ridgeline.jpg are tracing references only: each ink is matched to its palette hex rather than sampled.

creative_scope.fixed: Recover the four supplied painted/printed designs faithfully as vector paths. Preserve photographed lettering rather than retyping it. Follow the 55 mm artwork scale, 2.5 mm contour offset, 3 mm minimum corner radius and printer sheet spacing.
creative_scope.designer_choices: Draw two original companion illustrations with subject matter and visual rhythm that fit the coffee collection. Choose imposition within the printer's clearances. Newly set lettering follows the supplied type system; photographed lettering retains its original shape.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Recover only features supported by the references; do not describe an automatic trace as engraving, cutting, embroidery, or press ready without inspectable path evidence.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

deliverables.review_name: Meridian and Ash / Sticker imposed production sheet

commission.purpose: Supply one sheet the printer can separate into artwork and cutting paths.
content: Place the six designs with their corresponding cut paths on a separable CutContour layer.
Keep cut contours at least 10 mm from the sheet edge and 6 mm apart; preserve the 55 mm artwork scale.
export_settings: Production PDF/X-4 with embedded fonts or outlined lettering, CMYK artwork and the supplied PSO Coated v3 output intent. Convert palette colours from sRGB using this profile; preserve named spot cut lines separately.

305 x 457 mm page, 55 mm artwork scale, 10 mm sheet clearance and 6 mm contour gutters; CutContour remains a separate named layer and spot colour. PSO Coated v3 is the agreed CMYK exchange space, not a solvent/vinyl device profile: the printer handles the final RIP conversion and physical proof for white gloss vinyl.

deliverable_groups.name: Recovered sticker artwork
requirements: The design preserves its photographed original: meridian_window_mark.jpg for the window mark, with its painted lettering traced as painted rather than reset in a typeface, and meridian_bag_moth.jpg, meridian_bag_pourover.jpg and meridian_bag_ridgeline.jpg for bag designs 1, 2 and 3 respectively.
Interior negative space remains open at 55 mm.

deliverable_groups.name: Original companion sticker
requirements: The drawing belongs stylistically beside the recovered collection.
Interior negative space remains open at 55 mm.

deliverable_groups.name: Separate sticker cut contour
requirements: The contour is offset 2.5 mm from the artwork edge.
The minimum corner radius is 3 mm.
This file contains one cutting contour.
